title: [Internal Admin Dashboard] Allowlisted admin sees Internal tab and the Internal tools page
preconditions:
Signed in as a @example.com / @example.app staff user who is on the internal-admin allowlist (the same gate as Ledger Inspector / Chat Inspector).

The Internal Tooling card (task-template sharing) is shown only when the signed-in admin's practice is a template reseller. Know whether your practice is one before step 3; if it is not, the card is expected to be absent.
description: Maps to Phase 1 AC: dashboard lists all internal tools including sub-routes; linked in the nav for users who pass the real backend gate. Source: GET-17183.

steps.action: Sign in and look at the main app nav.
Click the Internal tab (or go to /internal).
steps.expected_result: The Internal tools page loads with the heading "Internal tools" (not Access denied, not a spinner that never resolves).

steps.action: Review the tool cards on the page.
steps.expected_result: Ledger Inspector (with a Practice activation sub-link) and Chat Inspector (with an Evals sub-link) are listed. An Internal Tooling card (task-template sharing) is listed only if your practice is a template reseller; otherwise it is absent and nothing else on the page hints at it.

steps.action: Open each listed card and sub-link: Ledger Inspector, Practice activation, Chat Inspector, Evals, and Internal Tooling if shown.
steps.expected_result: Each opens under /internal/... and loads; none shows Access denied or 403 for this allowlisted admin.

steps.action: Open the old inspector URLs directly: /ledger-inspector, /ledger-inspector/practice-activation, /chat-inspector, /chat-inspector/evals.
steps.expected_result: Each redirects to its /internal/... counterpart and loads the same tool.

It redirects to /internal/template-sharing. If your practice is a template reseller, the task-template sharing page loads. If it is not, an "Access denied — You do not have permission to access this tool" notification appears and you land back on the Internal tools page at /internal (not the client list; that landing is reserved for users with no internal access at all).
